sources.title: jayPark777/Qwen3.8-27B-Axon-MLQT · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B-Axon-MLQT is the world's first 3-Trit 0-SKIP MLQT quantized release of the groundbreaking 27B model, mathematically packed into 1.60 bpw via discrete ternary states ($ {-1, 0, +1}$) and calibrated across 496 importance matrix chunks.

sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MathVision: Qwen3.8-27B is evaluated using the fixed prompt: "Please reason step by step, and put your final answer within \boxed {}." For the remaining models, we report the higher score from two prompt variants—one with and one without the \boxed {} formatting requirement.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B - GitHub
sources.snippet: Welcome to the repository for Qwen3.8-27B —the latest native multimodal dense open-weight model released by Alibaba's Qwen team. Delivering top-tier performance for local hardware, Qwen3.8-27B excels at coding, agentic workflows, and office automation tasks.

sources.snippet: How does Qwen3.8-27B perform overall in AI benchmarks? + Qwen3.8-27B ranks #16 out of 228 models on the public BenchAlign leaderboard, with a score of 72.51/100.

sources.title: Qwen 3.8 27B - GroqDocs
sources.snippet: Model card for Qwen3.8-27B: a compact 27B multimodal (vision + text) model with thinking and instruct modes, frontier-level agentic coding, long-horizon tool use, and near-instant responses on Groq.
